# Checkpoint and Resume

On every resume, restore effective options and metadata, then enter step 1 policy preparation before any axis read, classification, scheduling or route. Replace cached permissions through `merge-flow prepare`, retain the resulting single policy in watch state, and use it for all gates and dispatch. A `never` to numeric triage change consults `merge-flow triage`; a paused result is recorded without reading bodies or inventing a count. Forbidden conditions produce would-do lines, never routes or reasons to wait. With no permitted route or running permitted check, cancel the scheduler and return the same policy-limited `Status: unavailable` report as on initial dispatch, with the named parent resume target. Preserve any deferred-issue batch awaiting the parent's user-facing approval; resuming is not approval to file it.

A foreground checkpoint ends an invocation while preserving the watch. Resumption requires the same conversation, or the complete checkpoint pasted into a new conversation before the resume command. A command alone in a new conversation starts a new watch; never claim to have restored state that is unavailable.

## Checkpoint Fields

Print a labelled `monitor-pr:monitor checkpoint` block with every field below, including explicit empty values for guards that have not been set. Store only watch metadata, never credentials or environment variable values.

| Field              | Contents                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Identity           | `OWNER`, `REPO`, `PR_NUMBER`, PR URL, head and base branch names, current head SHA, and whether the author is Dependabot                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Policy             | Prepared policy object, state-file path and triage status; resolve fresh permissions at each entry before any axis work                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Options            | Effective `--ticks`, `--rounds`, `--triage-after`, `--confirm-clean`, `--no-fix`, and `--interval` override, or `adaptive` when none was supplied                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Observations       | Helper-owned `observationFailures` for every closed registry kind; last named diagnostic; restore counters unchanged, rebuild outcomes from fresh reads                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Snapshot           | All four readiness axes, individual check states, latest Copilot review ID and SHA, that review's feedback probe result (open-thread count, the audit items, and the helper-owned registry retry counters), draft state, `mergeable`, `mergeStateStatus`, and informational `reviewDecision`                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Pacing             | Selected interval, mechanism, and completed foreground ticks for this invocation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Rounds             | Completed Copilot rounds and the watch's total round budget, and the count of the PR's earlier Copilot reviews that triage rounds start from; record counted review IDs so a review seen again cannot spend another round                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Review request     | Requested head SHAs, consecutive quiet ticks before a request, quiet ticks after the request for the current head, the notice review IDs a retry was requested for, and the ticks each such notice has stayed newest since its retry                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Processed feedback | The `review`, `notice` or `unclear` classification recorded for each Copilot review ID, so a resumed watch neither rereads nor reclassifies it; review IDs already passed to the feedback resolver, its outcome, summary URL, `Reviews read` line from the collapsed details, and any `Still open` Copilot notice entry for each, and the audit item ids each invocation recorded, with the head SHA each was recorded at                                                                    |
| Repair attempts    | Attempt counts keyed by check name, and any pending remote-moved push retry                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Confirmation       | Consecutive clean review count, review IDs, timestamps, and their head SHA                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Dependabot rebase  | Head SHAs already requested, current request SHA, quiet tick count, and any observed reply                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Merge policy       | The `merge-flow policy` result (`allowed`, `approvals`, and any `settingsNote` or `rulesNote`), the chosen method and its source, whether its one-time confirmation is still pending, and whether approval is required, unknown, or not required, with the sources that said so                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Merge watch        | Step 8 phase (`awaiting approval`, `offered`, `declined`, `merge requested`, or `none`), `READY_HEAD`, the `--awaited` decision, the background watch task ID or `none`, on the scheduled-task path the `--once` counts (`failures`, `mergedReads`) and the first tick's Unix time, and whether step 8f has run, with the merge commit it used. A background watch is not a scheduled continuation, but the foreground path never starts one, so its ID is `none` at a foreground checkpoint |
| Scheduled work     | Task or wakeup ID, or `none`; no scheduled continuation may remain active at a foreground checkpoint                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

Print the exact resume command with the explicit PR number and all effective options. For example:

```text
/monitor-pr:monitor 361 --ticks 3 --rounds 10 --triage-after 5 --confirm-clean --no-fix --interval 10m
```

Say to run that command in this conversation. For transfer to another conversation, say to paste the complete checkpoint first and verify the repository and branch there. Do not create a state file in the monitored repository automatically.

## Resume Procedure

1. Match the latest checkpoint to the resolved repository and PR. Restore all watch-state fields before classifying GitHub state. If required fields are missing, report the missing fields and ask for them; do not silently reset guards or infer that no prior action occurred.
1. Restore the effective options. A newly supplied option explicitly replaces its checkpoint value; omitted options retain their checkpoint values. A changed `--rounds` value sets the total watch budget, not additional rounds. Preserve completed rounds when comparing against it.
1. Reset only the foreground tick count for this invocation to zero. Retain the review request, counted and processed review IDs, per-check repair attempts, retry state, confirmation, Dependabot guards, and the merge policy and merge watch fields. The default three-tick boundary is not a new Copilot round budget.
1. Resolve the policy at step 1 before taking a fresh step 3 snapshot and count it as the first foreground tick. Never dispatch a cached readiness verdict. If the head changed, invalidate confirmation and reset the current-head quiet counters as required by the main workflow; retain histories of requested SHAs, counted and processed review IDs, and repair attempts. Those ordinary head-change transitions also apply during uninterrupted watches.
1. Resume step 4 candidate collection with the restored state, applying restrictions before every route. A review already requested for this head is not requested again. A review already processed is not processed again. The post-request quiet limit, unresolved feedback after processing, a current `unclear` classification and a non-clearing resolver outcome contribute the existing review-handling candidates; a stale review contributes the step 7a candidate. They never bypass restriction filtering. A review-body finding remaining in an already processed review is expected, not a new escalation candidate.
1. The helper's terminal lifecycle excludes all OPEN-only candidates. A PR that merged while the watch was paused contributes a `post-merge` candidate for step 8f unless it already ran. A restored step 8 phase contributes a `merge` candidate only once the snapshot is clean at the restored `READY_HEAD`. Pass either candidate through the same step 4 restriction filter before entry; never resume a phase directly. If the action remains permitted, reuse its recorded merge policy and answered method confirmation, and do not repeat an offer already made, declined or accepted into a queue at that head. A head that differs from `READY_HEAD` clears the phase as a `head` event would.
1. On the next foreground limit, replace the checkpoint with updated state, including the step 8 fields once the watch has reached step 8. On escalation, or once step 8f or a close ends the watch, end it rather than emit another resumable checkpoint.
